verdict.rationale: Supabase's CLI (`supabase init`/`start`), REST/GraphQL/Management APIs, and Docker-based self-hosting are all headless, non-interactive, and scriptable, and the runtime probe confirms the CLI runs keylessly via npx with no login — well suited to CI pipelines; migrations are explicitly designed to be captured in version control and run via CI rather than the dashboard, and branching supports per-PR automated environments. missing for 10: no first-party example of a CI pipeline config (e.g., GitHub Actions) running supabase CLI/migrations end-to-end, and community evidence shows friction around CI-driven migrations being an ideal not fully realized (dashboard-driven edits still common), which caps the score.
